posts: Diplomatic theater in the shadow of the G7: Prime Minister Carney meets Macron to discuss the shifting tides of global power. Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace. The diplomatic engagement is a standard, functional maintenance of international relations, fulfilling its stated purpose without deception.

Prime Minister Mark Carney is visiting Paris to meet President Emmanuel Macron ahead of the upcoming G7 summit. The discussions focus on geopolitical crises and the transition of the G7 presidency from Canada to France.
